The '''''Darter''''' is a ship on the [[River Erinin]]. It has a bluff bow and is twice as wide as the ''[[Blue Crane]]''. {{ref/book|3|39}}

== Activities ==
[[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] board the ''Darter'' at [[Jurene]].{{ref/book|3|39}}
A ship matching its description is noted by [[Mat]] as "still wallowing along well to the north" as he and [[Thom]] approach the town of [[Aringill]].{{ref/book|3|40}} 
The Darter does not stop at Aringill, but takes Egwene, Elayne and Nynaeve to [[Tear]]. {{ref/book|3|48}}
